The only valid vote (deepseek-v4-flash) correctly assessed it as safe. The inconclusive result from qwen3 was due to an API error on a non-executable metadata file (.SRCINFO), which does not indicate a security risk.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement stems from a tool error in the qwen3 model, which failed to review .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error, leading to an 'inconclusive' overall result. The deepseek model successfully reviewed all files and found no issues.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 encountered an LLM API error (HTTP 400) when reviewing .SRCINFO, causing it to return an inconclusive verdict.
learnings: The audit tool should handle transient LLM API errors on non-executable metadata files (like .SRCINFO) without failing the entire package audit or defaulting to 'inconclusive', as these files do not pose an execution risk during makepkg.
